# dilp

The goal of dilp is to help with analysis of quantitative fossil leaf
traits. Key functions included are:

- Digital Leaf Physiognomy -
  [`dilp()`](https://mjbutrim.github.io/dilp/reference/dilp.md)

  - Estimate mean annual temperature and mean annual precipitation using
    multiple linear regressions.

- Fossil Leaf Mass per Area -
  [`lma()`](https://mjbutrim.github.io/dilp/reference/lma.md)

  - Reconstruct leaf mass per area using leaf area and petiole width

- Leaf Margin Analysis -
  [`temp_slr()`](https://mjbutrim.github.io/dilp/reference/temp_slr.md)

  - Estimate mean annual temperature using leaf margin analysis

- Leaf Area Analysis -
  [`precip_slr()`](https://mjbutrim.github.io/dilp/reference/precip_slr.md)

  - Estimate mean annual precipitation using leaf area analysis

## Installation

You can install the stable version of dilp from your R session with:

``` r
install.packages("dilp")
```

You can install the development version of dilp from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("mjbutrim/dilp")
```

## Example

Find a basic example of running a DiLP and LMA analysis [in this
vignette](https://mjbutrim.github.io/dilp/articles/dilp.html)

For ease of use, a template spreadsheet for data collection can be found
here: [DiLP Data Collection
Template](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1AOAftWBAE0RhrUewBZDSL81BIUq0Gmhw/view?usp=sharing)

If you encounter any problems, or would like to request a feature,
please create an issue [here](https://github.com/mjbutrim/dilp/issues)

# Package index

## Key functions

- [`dilp()`](https://mjbutrim.github.io/dilp/reference/dilp.md) :
  Generate DiLP results
- [`lma()`](https://mjbutrim.github.io/dilp/reference/lma.md) : Generate
  a suite of leaf mass per area results
- [`temp_slr()`](https://mjbutrim.github.io/dilp/reference/temp_slr.md)
  : Estimate temperature with simple linear regression
- [`precip_slr()`](https://mjbutrim.github.io/dilp/reference/precip_slr.md)
  : Estimate precipitation with simple linear regression

## Other functions

- [`dilp_cca()`](https://mjbutrim.github.io/dilp/reference/dilp_cca.md)
  : Test if site leaf physiognomy falls within the physiognomic space of
  the DiLP calibration dataset
- [`dilp_errors()`](https://mjbutrim.github.io/dilp/reference/dilp_errors.md)
  : Check for common errors in DiLP measurements
- [`dilp_outliers()`](https://mjbutrim.github.io/dilp/reference/dilp_outliers.md)
  : Identify outlier specimens
- [`dilp_processing()`](https://mjbutrim.github.io/dilp/reference/dilp_processing.md)
  : Process raw leaf physiognomic data
- [`calc_lma()`](https://mjbutrim.github.io/dilp/reference/calc_lma.md)
  : Generate leaf mass per area results
- [`view_regressions()`](https://mjbutrim.github.io/dilp/reference/view_regressions.md)
  : View preloaded regressions

## Built in datasets

- [`McAbeeExample`](https://mjbutrim.github.io/dilp/reference/McAbeeExample.md)
  : McAbee Example Data
- [`climate_calibration_data`](https://mjbutrim.github.io/dilp/reference/climate_calibration_data.md)
  : Climate Calibration Data
- [`physiognomy_calibration_data`](https://mjbutrim.github.io/dilp/reference/physiognomy_calibration_data.md)
  : Physiognomy Calibration Data
